// CHAOS-5156: closes a coverage gap codex round r2 on #2266 surfaced --
// the mixed corpus_go_rust directory previously let a Go-only fixture
// silently satisfy Rust's "catch"/"?" coverage too (both were only ever
// exercised by Go source). Rust has no catch keyword (a bare identifier,
// same as Go's own catch_token_coverage.go.txt), and "?" here is Rust's
// REAL error-propagation operator, not a hand-added token.
fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<i32, String> {
    let catch = 0;
    let n = s.parse::<i32>().map_err(|_| "bad")?;
    if n > catch {
        Ok(n)
    } else {
        Err(String::from("too small"))
    }
}
